messages:
zoe: quick sync on spend dashboard tweaks  i'm torn between a compact scope menu vs chip row for org/project selection on narrow screens. prototype attached.
mike: compact menu wins for vertical density. chips look busy.
priya: chips are discoverable though. maybe show breadcrumb + a mini menu (current scope visible, tap to change).
henry: breadcrumb + menu seems the best compromise. preserves context but saves space.
zoe: agreed. implementation note: breadcrumb text should be truncated with ellipsis for long org names, but aria-label must expose full name.
mike: accessibility nit: when scope changes, fire an aria-live polite message: "Scope changed to Project: payments-service" so screen reader users aren't lost.
priya: also add a tiny info tooltip on the scope control: "Switch to project to view per-project cost and token breakdown" (appear on focus too).
henry: legend placement question: inline compact row under title vs collapsible panel to the right. If we collapse to panel, we need a visible summary of selected series.
zoe: proposal: summary chips (text-only) visible; open panel shows swatches + toggles + pattern overlays for colorblindness.
mike: pattern overlays are great. also make legend toggles real checkboxes with aria-checked and include `aria-label=\"Toggle: Org spend series\"`.
priya: copy tweak for the legend button: instead of "Show legend" use "Legend & visibility" — shorter and signals settings.
henry: invoice/export CTA confusion again: support reported users clicking Download expecting CSV. change primary CTA to "Download invoice (PDF)" and add secondary link "Export ledger (CSV)". also show small helper: "PDFs are month-based; CSV is a line-item ledger."
zoe: for bulk exports, add an estimate step: show number of invoices and approximate size, and if >50 invoices auto-queue and email link when ready.
mike: backend note: PDFs are generated per-month; if UI allows custom ranges either snap to months or warn users "PDFs will be split by month". devs, which is easier?
henry: snapping to month in UI is simplest; if users insist on day-level CSV we still support it.
priya: mobile layout: legend summary chips should be tappable to open panel; ensure tap targets are >=44px.
ux-bot: Prototype update: https://figma.com/file/spend-compact-menu-legend (pinned by @zoe).
zoe: i'll update figma with breadcrumb+menu, legend summary chips & panel with patterns, legend button labeled "Legend & visibility", invoice CTAs clarified, month-snap behavior for PDFs, and export estimate modal. moving to backlog if no objections.
mike: no objections. i'll add tickets for accessibility details (aria-live messages, checkbox roles, focus styles).
priya: i'll run an a11y quick pass once dev preview is available.
henry: thanks all. :+1:
